newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkey to collect nuclear plant bids on Sept 4.
newsitem.headline: Turkey to collect nuclear plant bids on Sept 4.

text.p: Turkey will not extend further the bid submission deadline for its first nuclear power plant tender and it will collect the bids on September 4, a senior energy official said on Thursday.
"The deadline is September 4. There will be no more extensions," Ugur Dogan, energy ministry undersecretary, told Reuters.
The ministry had extended the deadline by about two months from its original date of June 30.
Dogan said three foreign-led consortia were expected to turn up for the tender of the plant, to cost around $2.5 billion and to have a capacity range of 2,400 MegaWatts (MW) to 2,800 MW.
The plant, to be built on the southern Turkish coast, will be fully financed by the builder on a turnkey basis.
